title: Beautifully designed 3 bedroom 2.5 bathroom home
description:
Welcome to your fully furnished, designer decorated home. It's cozy, beautiful and centrally-located. There’s a hospital, grocery store and shopping areas down the street. The house is a 10 minute drive to the hot spots in East Nashville & Germantown & 15 minutes to downtown Nashville. Relax in the quiet tree filled backyard which sits on top a hill and gaze at the stars or listen to the birds singing during the day. 3 BEDROOM 2.5 BATHROOM HOME

The space
Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish home. Relax in the backyard and enjoy the night stars or sunshine and bird songs during the day. Two rooms have a dedicated work space while the primary sweet has a walk in closet and duel sink bathroom with walk in shower

Guest access
There’s a keypad for digital access. You will receive a 4 digit code when you book. Please be sure to press the lock button when leaving and the door will automatically lock

Other things to note
This home is a non-smoking, no drugs and no parties home. Only approved guests are allowed on the property.
